operation.title: CAP-TOPOLOGY-01 — semantic obligation subject topology, a discovery adjudication
operation.authority: Discovery only. No repair, no schema ratified, no clause authored, no docket item created. SP-R06 remains held. T(A)/CR5-B03 untouched — DOCKET-01 is a separate organ per founder direction.
operation.question_put: For each RC-0001 semantic requirement: WHAT is obligated? Not: which element should we attach it to.

headline.subject_classes_required: 7, one of them outside the founder's probe list
headline.verdict: ELEMENT is not the universal semantic subject of capability obligation, and is not even the majority case. It is the minimal subject for roughly one obligation in six.

relational.construction: record("A"), record("B") both supported individually; actual ordering B -> A.
relational.requirement_failed: SP-024 canonical history order; SP-044 if the inversion occurs at history join; SP-045 if the order is not total.
relational.every_element_individually_succeeds: YES — both records satisfy SP-032, SP-162, SP-037, SP-038; complete satisfies SP-034.
relational.the_arbitrariness_proof: If one insists on attaching the failure to an element, ask WHICH. Attach to record("B")? Its own admission satisfied every clause; A's position moved. Attach to record("A")? It was admitted first and correctly. Attach to complete? Only available under SP-044 if the inversion happens at history join. THE REPRESENTATION FORCES A CHOICE FOR WHICH NO CLAUSE SUPPLIES A PRINCIPLE. Two embodiments could localize the same semantic failure to different elements and diverge under SP-152 while behaving identically. SP-045 closes the escape entirely: non-totality is a property of the order, and there is no element at which totality is evaluated.

boundary.construction: record("A") supported, Entry exists; restart; after restart the Entry is missing.
boundary.every_element_individually_succeeds: YES — record("A") succeeded and the Entry existed.
boundary.structurally_inexpressible_not_merely_ar: The only element in the neighbourhood is the boundary, and SP-156 makes ADMITTED its ONLY lawful disposition. Under v0.5 there exists NO element to which this failure may lawfully attach. Cold Review 005 recorded the consequence as CR5-09 (SP-155 ∧ SP-156 ∧ SP-150 jointly unsatisfiable); this adjudication reaches the same wall from the other side and identifies the cause — a boundary-span obligation given an element-indexed representation.

mandated_counterexamples.what_the_pair_establishes: operation support ≠ semantic requirement satisfaction. An embodiment may support every operation it is asked to perform and still fail RC-0001, because RC-0001's obligations are not all obligations ABOUT operations.

why_sp168_could_not_have_been_completed.of_the_19_clauses_the_table_invokes: 9 are ELEMENT-subject and correctly attached; 6 are BOUNDARY, 3 are RELATION, 1 is ENTITY — all attached to an element anyway.

three_distinct_defects.2_category_error: 10 of the 19 rows attach a non-element-subject obligation to an element. NOT FILLABLE — adding rows of this kind adds more category errors.
three_distinct_defects.3_unreachability: 71 further obligations have subjects the representation has no slot for. NOT FILLABLE AT ALL.

why_sp168_could_not_have_been_completed.conclusion: 'SP-168 needs more rows' is the wrong diagnosis, exactly as the founder anticipated. The table is not an incomplete instance of a correct design; it is a complete-as-possible instance of a design that expresses one subject class, applied to a corpus that has seven.

discovered_topology.PROGRAM: 35 (31.5%) — standing properties of the embodiment, true or false before any element is presented. SP-013's witness observability and SP-110's totality of view are lacked at every position and none in particular.
discovered_topology.NON_OBLIGATION: 21 (18.9%) — nothing a substrate can fail: scope statements, founder reproductions, explicit non-decisions (SP-026, SP-027, SP-047), and the repair's own machinery clauses.
discovered_topology.ELEMENT: 16 (14.4%) — success conditions, refusal law, atomicity, distinguishability, refusal precedence, content presence. These and only these have the shape v0.5's representation assumes.
discovered_topology.RELATION: 12 (10.8%) — order and correspondence among elements or entries. SP-021 is definitional: an Entry's identity IS its position, so identity is relational and cannot be a property of the record act that created it.
discovered_topology.BOUNDARY: 9 (8.1%) — ordered pairs of L-fact sets separated by a discontinuity.
discovered_topology.TRACE: 9 (8.1%) — whole presented sequences. NOTE: SP-043, the clause CR3-B01 was fought over, already has a sequence subject. The topology discovered here was PARTLY DISCOVERED IN v0.4 AND NOT GENERALISED.
discovered_topology.ENTITY: 5 (4.5%) — an Entry or Ledger over its lifetime. SP-025 obliges immutability INCLUDING AT MOMENTS WHEN NO ELEMENT IS PRESENTED: a substrate rewriting Entry content during idle background compaction violates it with no operation in flight. No element-indexed representation can witness a failure that occurs between elements.
discovered_topology.EMBODIMENT_PAIR: 4 (3.6%) — OTHER_DISCOVERED, outside the probe list. See below.

the_discovered_class.finding: These obligations have NO SINGLE-EMBODIMENT LOCUS AT ALL. SP-091 is a three-way equality — reference trace = normalized Web trace = normalized iOS trace. No single embodiment can satisfy or fail it. SP-152 obliges TWO embodiments to agree; SP-173 fixes the target cardinality at two; SP-114 is the witness's cross-substrate comparison.
the_discovered_class.structural_consequence: A capability record is emitted BY ONE EMBODIMENT ABOUT ITSELF. These four can never lawfully appear in any failed-requirement set — not because the invocation table omits them, but because there is no embodiment to which they could be predicated.
the_discovered_class.self_reference_hazard: SP-152 is the comparison rule itself. Under SP-167 it is a member of its own requirement set, and under SP-169 an embodiment could name it as a requirement it 'cannot honor' — a self-referential absurdity the current design does not exclude.

second_finding_running_opposite_to_CR5_B.finding: SP-167 sets the requirement set to all 111 normative clauses. Roughly a fifth of that set — 21 clauses — can never be a member of any failed-requirement set under ANY substrate whatsoever.
second_finding_running_opposite_to_CR5_B.significance: The requirement set is simultaneously OVER-INCLUSIVE (here) and UNDER-REACHABLE (CR5-B01). Both follow from defining the requirement set by DOCUMENT POSITION rather than by WHAT IS OBLIGATED — which is precisely the question CAP-TOPOLOGY-01 was authorised to ask.

on_the_founders_RequirementResult_sketch: `subject` cannot be a single type — seven classes with different cardinalities and temporal extents; the discriminator belongs to the requirement's own declaration, not to the run.

Subject identity must be constructible: RELATION needs to name the tuple, BOUNDARY the two sides, ENTITY the Entry plus an interval. ELEMENT subjects are the only ones a presented index alone identifies.
EMBODIMENT-PAIR obligations must be excluded from self-reported results BY CONSTRUCTION, not by omission from a table.
NON-OBLIGATION clauses must be excluded from the requirement set, or SP-169's exactness is defined over members that can never be failed.
implications_for_representation_stated_n.explicit_non_solution: CR5-B02's collision defect — U′ and V′ both publishing {SP-020} — is NOT repaired by any of this. Clause identity under-distinguishes because one clause can bundle several obligations (SP-020 binds correspondence, content equality and status). Subject topology and OBLIGATION GRANULARITY are two different problems; this adjudication addresses only the first. A later movement must not treat CR5-B02 as collaterally solved.

what_this_does_not_decide: It repairs nothing; v0.5 is unmodified and its digest is recomputed unchanged.
It ratifies no schema, including RequirementResult.
It does not touch T(A), CR5-B03, or any docket item — DOCKET-01 is a separate organ with a different pathology.
It does not decide obligation granularity (CR5-B02).
It does not claim the seven classes are exhaustive; the probe list was deliberately not treated as doctrine.
It does not establish that a correct representation exists — only what one would have to express.
self_limitation: The classification is AUTHOR-SIDE JUDGMENT by the same lineage that authored v0.5, mechanical only in its bookkeeping. A lineage-independent reviewer could reasonably reclassify individual rows, most plausibly at the PROGRAM/ELEMENT margin and at RELATION/ENTITY where SP-021's positional identity reads either way. Such reclassification would move the percentages but not the conclusion, which rests on the two counterexamples (constructions, not classifications) and on the EMBODIMENT-PAIR argument (structural, about what a single embodiment can predicate of itself).
